correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the source stochastic I,B drift and quadratic variation with u=I+gB; its environmental coefficient has supremum beta_c H/K-g omega and requires g>g0. Maximizing infected coefficient beta_h s-k(g)s^2/2 over 0<=s<=H yields Phi(g), with explicit piecewise branch. k(g)=xi^2 zeta/sqrt(zeta^2+(gHxi)^2) strictly decreases for g>0. Thus Phi(g) nondecreases, F(g)=Phi(g)+g sigma strictly increases (sigma>0), proving existence of feasible g>g0 iff F(g0)<mu1. The source logarithmic martingale argument then proves decay, assuming its stated positive invariant region and martingale bounds. Independent fresh arithmetic using printed Sec6.3 data gives g0=.5978369905956114, Phi(g0)=.21644639763126833, F(g0)=.9069481217691995<mu1=1.0152548, and R*(g0)=.9053382105026572. The log-drift criterion, not an iff extinction criterion, is the final claim.
